name: answercloud
description: Launch a website from one prompt: share your email, organization name, and brief, then build and publish with temporary site-only access. Finish account setup by email afterward.

interface.shortDescription: Launch a website from one prompt
interface.longDescription: Start with the public guide at https://answer.cloud/build-site. Its wizard asks for your email, organization name, and website brief, reserves an isolated first site, and builds and publishes an Astro website with temporary site-only access. Finish account setup from your email afterward. The optional plugin bundles the launch workflow and the authenticated tools for subsequent site changes, editable CMS collections, and AI companion sites.
defaultPrompt: Build me a website on https://answer.cloud/build-site.
Build and deploy an AEO-friendly static site using the official answer.cloud style defaults
Set up editable CMS collection templates for my site
Create an AI companion site for my existing website
Make my answer.cloud chat experience match the rest of my website
